e.title: **一份**输入来源换代**的行级对照数据：**并逐字写明这些数**不是什么****：Zenodo 记录 `10.5281/zenodo.22218362`（PayBeacon，CMS HCRIS FY2023 → FY2024）——**⭐ 1,540 行可比基准、**换代前后并列**；**⭐ 逐字**「**It is not a live-job posting index, package quote, paycheck estimate, or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage**」**；**⭐ 而归属被逐字切断**「**PayBeacon 的派生结论不可归于 CMS、HCRIS、BLS 或任何州机构**」**；**⭐ 包内自带 **Frictionless `datapackage.json` ＋ **CITATION.cff ＋ **`checksums.sha256`****
e.title_en: A row-level comparison dataset of one thousand five hundred and forty benchmarks before and after an upstream source release changed, which states verbatim what the numbers are not and detaches the derived conclusions from the public agencies whose data feeds them, shipped as a Frictionless data package with a citation file and a checksum manifest.
e.title_hk: **一份**輸入來源換代**的行級對照資料：**並逐字寫明這些數**不是什麼****：Zenodo 記錄 `10.5281/zenodo.22218362`（PayBeacon，CMS HCRIS FY2023 → FY2024）——**⭐ 1,540 行可比基準、**換代前後並列**；**⭐ 逐字**「**It is not a live-job posting index, package quote, paycheck estimate, or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage**」**；**⭐ 而歸屬被逐字切斷**「**PayBeacon 的派生結論不可歸於 CMS、HCRIS、BLS 或任何州機構**」**；**⭐ 包內自帶 **Frictionless `datapackage.json` ＋ **CITATION.cff ＋ **`checksums.sha256`****
e.summary: **paybeacon-hcris-benchmark**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22218362`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22218361`****）**是一份**行级的「**上游来源换代**」对照数据****——**逐字标题为**「**CMS HCRIS FY2024 benchmark changes — row-level PayBeacon dataset**」**，**创建者逐字为** PayBeacon**。**本次实测**：**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**Zenodo 创建 **2026-09-08****；**包内 **6 个文件****（**主表 **388,241 字节、**`datapackage.json`、**`checksums.sha256`、**`CITATION.cff`、**`citation.bib`、**`README.md`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：写明不是什么**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **逐字划出「**这不是什么**」**（**不是live 招聘指数、**不是报价、**不是工资估算、**也不是「**可接单量同比变化**」**的证明**）**；**② **归属被切断**（**派生结论**不可归于四家公共机构**，**而**原始材料**保留其**政府作品地位**）**；**③ **换代前后**并列成行**，**并记录**两个**来源发布键****；**④ **随包给出**可执行校验指令**（**`shasum -a 256 -c checksums.sha256`**）**。**⚠️ 本次未下载主表。
e.summary_hk: **paybeacon-hcris-benchmark**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22218362`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22218361`****）**是一份**行級的「**上游來源換代**」對照資料****——**逐字標題為**「**CMS HCRIS FY2024 benchmark changes — row-level PayBeacon dataset**」**，**創建者逐字為** PayBeacon**。**本次實測**：**類型 dataset**、**許可 CC-BY-4.0**、**Zenodo 建立 2026-09-08**；**包內 6 個檔案****（**主表 388,241 位元組、**`datapackage.json`、**`checksums.sha256`、**`CITATION.cff`、**`citation.bib`、**`README.md`**）**。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：寫明不是什麼**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **逐字劃出「**這不是什麼**」**；**② **歸屬被切斷**（**派生結論不可歸於四家公共機構**）**；**③ **換代前後並列成行**，**並記錄兩個來源發布鍵****；**④ **隨包給出**可執行校驗指令****。**⚠️ 本次未下載主表。
e.summary_en: The Zenodo record paybeacon-hcris-benchmark, with a separate concept identifier, **is a row-level dataset comparing benchmarks before and after an upstream public source release changed**, registered as a dataset under a Creative Commons attribution licence and created on the registry on 2026-09-08, with six files inside: a main table of about three hundred and eighty-eight kilobytes, a Frictionless data package description, a checksum file, two citation files and a readme. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating what the numbers are not**, and **four things are worth reading: the scope note says verbatim that this is not a live job posting index, a package quote, a paycheck estimate or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage; the attribution is detached, with the derived conclusions stated as not attributable to the four public agencies whose materials feed the product while the source materials retain their government-work status; the comparison puts the previous and current benchmarks side by side in the same row and records both source release keys; and the package ships an executable verification instruction**. **The main table was not downloaded this round.**
e.body:
**paybeacon-hcris-benchmark**（Zenodo 记录 **`10.5281/zenodo.22218362`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22218361`****）**是一份**行级的「**上游来源换代**」对照数据****——**逐字标题为**「**CMS HCRIS FY2024 benchmark changes — row-level PayBeacon dataset**」**，**创建者逐字为** PayBeacon**。**本次实测**：**类型 dataset**、**许可 **CC-BY-4.0**、**Zenodo 创建 **2026-09-08**、**包内 **6 个文件**（**逐字为** `paybeacon-hcris-fy2024-benchmark-changes.csv` **388,241 字节、**`datapackage.json` **4,440 字节、**`CITATION.cff` **1,172 字节、**`citation.bib` **452 字节、**`README.md` **1,976 字节、**`checksums.sha256` **428 字节**）**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**登记处纪律：写明不是什么**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Zenodo API 元数据、包内 README 与 `datapackage.json` 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**这是什么**」与「**这不是什么**」**并列写出****——**README 与记录描述逐字为**：**「**This is a deterministic model-source comparison. It is **not** a live-job posting index, package quote, paycheck estimate, or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage. **Values are modeled gross-wage benchmarks before tax and exclude stipends, overtime, reimbursements, insurance, and other package components.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这是本轮最值得抄的一处**：**⭐ 即**四个「**不是**」**分别对应**四种**最容易被误读的用法**（**实时需求、**对外报价、**实发工资、**接单量变化**）**——**⭐ 这与本站第 347 轮「**防误读**」、第 336 轮「**宁可拒绝也不假装**」同向**：**一份数据**能不能被误用**，**往往**取决于**它自己有没有先说出边界**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 归属被**逐字切断**，**而**上游材料地位被**保留****——**逐字**：**「**PayBeacon 的派生 conclusions are **not attributable to CMS, HCRIS, BLS, or any state agency**. **Source materials retain their original public-domain or government-work status and notices.** PayBeacon 的原创 derived release is offered under CC BY 4.0.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独抄**：**⭐ 即**「**我基于公共数据做了加工，**但**结论是我的，**不是那家机构的**」**与「**上游材料的公共属性不变**」**两件事被分开写**——**⭐ 这与本站第 357 轮「**许可形态分类**」同向**：**派生层的许可**与**源头层的地位**是两件事**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 换代前后被放在**同一行**，**且**记录了两个**来源发布键****——**逐字**：**「**This package contains **1,540** comparable PayBeacon travel-healthcare occupation and location rows before and after the validated source transition from **May 2025|FY2023|CY2026** to **May 2025|FY2024|CY2026**.**」**；**⭐ 而** `datapackage.json` 的 **`sources`** 字段逐字列出**来源登记页与这两个发布键**（**逐字为** `May 2025|FY2023|CY2026` 与** `May 2025|FY2024|CY2026`**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得抄**：**⭐ 即**「**换代**」**不是**一句说明**，**而是**落在每一行上的两个键**（**逐字字段名** `previous_source_key` 与** `current_source_key`**）**——**⭐ 即**任何一行**都能回答**「**它来自哪一次发布**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 字段模式（**schema）逐字段写明**，**且**带类型与枚举****——**实测** `datapackage.json` **资源档逐字给出 **14 个字段**：**`stable_report_id`（**永久报告标识**）、**`occupation`、**`geography`、**`geography_slug`、**`geography_type`（**枚举 metro／state**）、**`state`、**`previous_weekly`（**整数，**美元）**、**`current_weekly`、**`change_weekly`、**`change_percent`、**`previous_source_key`、**`current_source_key`、**`updated`（**日期**）、**`benchmark_url`（**URI 格式**）**；**⭐ 并**逐字说明** `geography_type` **只允许两个取值**，**而** `benchmark_url` **是**永久公开基准页**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**每一行都带永久链接**」**这一点值得记**：**⭐ 即**读者**可以从数据集里的任意一行**走回**它的公开页面**——**⭐ 这与本站第 339 轮「**每个值指回它的来源**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 包内六件的**角色**被逐条列出，**并给出**可执行的校验指令****——**逐字**：**`paybeacon-hcris-fy2024-benchmark-changes.csv`**（**clean UTF-8 row-level CSV**）、**`datapackage.json`**（**Frictionless Tabular Data Package metadata and column schema**）、**`CITATION.cff`**（**Citation File Format 1.2**）、**`citation.bib`**（**copy-ready BibTeX**）、**`checksums.sha256`**（**SHA-256 integrity values**）**；**⭐ 并逐字给出校验方法**「**Use `shasum -a 256 -c checksums.sha256` from this directory to verify the downloaded files.**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**给出**可执行校验指令**比「**附带校验和文件**」更有用**：**⭐ 即**使用者**不需要**自己知道**该怎么用那个文件**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 溯源入口被列成一套（**五个链接**）****——**逐字为**方法学页、**来源登记页、**数据字典、**更正政策页** 与**复用许可页**——**⭐ 本词条认为**「**更正政策**」**单独立页**这一点值得记**：**⭐ 即**一份数据**如何被更正**，**是**它可信度的一部分**；**⭐ 这与本站第 348 轮「**自验证**」、第 353 轮「**同源多形**」同向**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 两处日期不一致（本次实测）**——**⭐ README 与 `datapackage.json` 逐字给出的发布日均为 **2026-07-19****（**逐字** Published: 2026-07-19**、**`"created": "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z"`**、**`"version": "1.0.0"`**）**，**而** Zenodo 记录的**创建时间为 **2026-09-08****。**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期而不替它调和**，**并指出**两者**可能指**「**这份报告首次发布**」与「**它被存入登记处**」**两件事**（**⭐ 本词条**不据此推断**）**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 主题相关性须如实说明**——**⭐ 该数据的内容是**旅行医疗人力（**travel-healthcare**）的**职业与地区工资基准**，**与医疗保险的**成本侧**相关**（**⭐ 其字段与描述**不含任何理赔、**保单或健康结果数据**）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此把它放在**医疗保险成本输入**一侧**，**并如实指出**：**它**不是**保险数据本身**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]] 覆盖「**每个值自带发布机构与生效年份**」的常数数据集**，**[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、**[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]] 覆盖联邦医保数据**，**[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 覆盖医院价格透明数据**，**[[hcc-python]]、**[[icd-hcc-mappings]] 覆盖风险调整与编码映射**，**[[collective-health-burning-cost]]、**[[medical-cost-prediction]] 覆盖医疗成本建模**，**[[uae-health-pricing-model]] 覆盖健康险定价**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**一份**上游来源换代**的行级对照：**逐字写明不是什么 ＋ **归属与上游地位分开 ＋ **每行带两个来源键与永久链接 ＋ **随包给出可执行校验**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的五点**：**① **先写「**这不是什么**」，**再写「**这是什么**」**；**② **派生结论**与**上游机构**的归属**要分开**，**而**上游材料的公共地位**要保留**；**③ **换代前后**放在同一行**，**并**逐行记录**两个来源键**；**④ **每一行都带**永久公开链接**；**⑤ **给出**可直接执行的校验命令**，**而不只是附一个校验和文件**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载主表**（**未读 1,540 行中任何一行、**未复算任何变化百分比、**未核对校验和**），**故**不主张**其行数、**字段取值或任何数值结果**；**⭐ 所述一切来自**README、**`datapackage.json` 与登记处元数据**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核实** `checksums.sha256` **是否与实际文件一致**（**⭐ 需要下载文件**）**；**也未核实** `datapackage.json` **是否通过 Frictionless 校验**。**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**「**1,540 行可比**」**这一口径**（**⭐ 即**可比性**如何判定**）**；**也未核实**两个**来源发布键**的实际含义**（**⭐ 逐字只知它们形如** `May 2025|FY2023|CY2026`**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**「**validated source transition**」**这一说法**（**⭐ 描述称该换代**已获验证**，**但**本次未读方法学页**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**该产品与** CMS HCRIS **的实际取数关系**（**⭐ 描述只提到来源换代**，**未说明取数路径**）**；**也未核实**其**面向的市场与用途**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**创建者的**组织性质**（**⭐ 记录只给出 **PayBeacon** 这一名称**）**；**也未核实**其**与所引公共机构**是否有任何正式关系**（**⭐ 描述逐字声明**不可归属**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核实**该数据**是否为付费产品的一部分**（**⭐ 其页面或存在商业背景，**本次未访问任何链接**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ **许可**为** CC-BY-4.0**（**须署名**）**；**⭐ 而**上游材料**逐字保留其**公共领域或政府作品地位**——**⭐ 引用时**两者都应注明**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目的**窗口状况**：**⭐ Zenodo 创建 **2026-09-08**（**在解冻窗口之内**）**，**而**包内自述发布日 **2026-07-19**（**在窗口之外**）**——**⭐ 本词条**如实并列这两个日期**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该数据**既不是保险数据本身、**也不是任何工资或报价依据**，**不得**用于任何实际人力成本或保费判断**。
e.body_hk:
**paybeacon-hcris-benchmark**（Zenodo 記錄 **`10.5281/zenodo.22218362`**，**概念 DOI **`10.5281/zenodo.22218361`****）**是一份**行級的「**上游來源換代**」對照資料****——**逐字標題為**「**CMS HCRIS FY2024 benchmark changes — row-level PayBeacon dataset**」**，**創建者逐字為** PayBeacon**。**本次實測**：**類型 dataset**、**許可 CC-BY-4.0**、**Zenodo 建立 2026-09-08**、**包內 6 個檔案**（`paybeacon-hcris-fy2024-benchmark-changes.csv` 388,241 位元組、`datapackage.json` 4,440、`CITATION.cff` 1,172、`citation.bib` 452、`README.md` 1,976、`checksums.sha256` 428**）**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**登記處紀律：寫明不是什麼**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Zenodo API 元資料、包內 README 與 `datapackage.json` 實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 「**這是什麼**」與「**這不是什麼**」並列寫出****——**逐字**「**This is a deterministic model-source comparison. It is not a live-job posting index, package quote, paycheck estimate, or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage. Values are modeled gross-wage benchmarks before tax and exclude stipends, overtime, reimbursements, insurance, and other package components.**」**——**⭐ 即**四個「**不是**」**分別對應**四種最容易被誤讀的用法**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 歸屬被**逐字切斷**，**上游材料地位被保留****——**逐字**「**PayBeacon 的派生 conclusions are not attributable to CMS, HCRIS, BLS, or any state agency. Source materials retain their original public-domain or government-work status and notices. PayBeacon 的原创 derived release is offered under CC BY 4.0.**」**——**⭐ 即**派生層的許可**與**源頭層的地位**是兩件事**。**⭐⭐⭐ ③ 換代前後放在**同一行**，**並記錄兩個來源發布鍵****——**逐字**「**This package contains 1,540 comparable PayBeacon travel-healthcare occupation and location rows before and after the validated source transition from May 2025|FY2023|CY2026 to May 2025|FY2024|CY2026.**」**；**`datapackage.json` 的 `sources` 逐字列出來源登記頁與這兩個發布鍵**；**⭐ 而**每行帶** `previous_source_key` 與 `current_source_key`**——**任何一行都能回答**「**它來自哪一次發布**」。**⭐⭐ ④ 欄位模式逐欄寫明並帶類型與枚舉****——**實測 14 個欄位**：`stable_report_id`、`occupation`、`geography`、`geography_slug`、`geography_type`（**枚舉 metro／state**）、`state`、`previous_weekly`（**整數、**美元**）、`current_weekly`、`change_weekly`、`change_percent`、`previous_source_key`、`current_source_key`、`updated`（**日期**）、`benchmark_url`（**URI**）**；**⭐ 每行帶**永久公開連結**，**讀者可從任意一行走回它的公開頁面**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 包內六件的角色逐條列出並給出可執行校驗指令****——**逐字**「**Use `shasum -a 256 -c checksums.sha256` from this directory to verify the downloaded files.**」**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ 溯源入口五個連結**：方法學頁、**來源登記頁、**資料字典、**更正政策頁、**複用許可頁**——**⭐ 「**更正政策**」單獨立頁**這一點值得記**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 兩處日期不一致（本次實測）**：**README 與 `datapackage.json` 逐字給出的發布日均為 2026-07-19**（**逐字** Published: 2026-07-19**、**`"created": "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z"`、**`"version": "1.0.0"`**）**，**而 Zenodo 記錄建立時間為 2026-09-08**——**⭐ 如實並列而不替它調和**。**⭐⭐ ⑧ 主題相關性**：**內容是**旅行醫療人力的職業與地區工資基準**，**與醫療保險的**成本側**相關**（**不含理賠、**保單或健康結果資料**）**；**⭐ 如實指出**它**不是**保險資料本身**。**⭐⭐ ⑨ 與池內條目的關係**：[[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[cms-desynpuf-insurance-claims]]、[[cms-beneficiary-fhir]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]]、[[hcc-python]]、[[icd-hcc-mappings]]、[[collective-health-burning-cost]]、[[medical-cost-prediction]]、[[uae-health-pricing-model]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**上游來源換代的行級對照：逐字寫明不是什麼＋歸屬與上游地位分開＋每行帶兩個來源鍵與永久連結＋隨包給出可執行校驗**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[us-mortgage-financing-constants]]、[[healthcare-mrf-api]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 五點最值得借鑑**：**① **先寫「**這不是什麼**」**；**② **派生結論**與**上游機構**的歸屬分開**；**③ **換代前後放同一行並逐行記錄來源鍵**；**④ **每行帶永久連結**；**⑤ **給出可執行校驗命令**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有下載主表**（**未讀 1,540 行中任何一行、**未複算任何變化百分比、**未核對校驗和**），**不主張**其行數、**欄位取值或任何數值結果**；**所述一切來自 README、**`datapackage.json` 與登記處元資料**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 未核實** `checksums.sha256` **是否與實際檔案一致**；**未核實** `datapackage.json` **是否通過 Frictionless 校驗**。**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**「**1,540 行可比**」**這一判準**；**未核實**兩個**來源發布鍵**的實際含義**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**「**validated source transition**」**這一說法**（**未讀方法學頁**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**該產品與 **CMS HCRIS** 的實際取數關係**；**未核實**其面向的市場與用途**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**創建者的**組織性質**；**未核實**其**與所引公共機構**是否有正式關係**（**描述逐字聲明**不可歸屬**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ 未核實**該資料**是否為付費產品的一部分**（**未訪問任何連結**）**。**⑧ ⚠️ 許可為 CC-BY-4.0**（**須署名**）**；**上游材料逐字保留其**公共領域或政府作品地位**——**引用時兩者都應註明**。**⑨ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**Zenodo 建立 2026-09-08（**窗口內**）**，**包內自述發布日 2026-07-19（**窗口外**）**——**如實並列**。**⑩ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該資料**既不是保險資料本身、**也不是任何工資或報價依據**，**不得**用於任何實際人力成本或保費判斷**。

The Zenodo record paybeacon-hcris-benchmark, with a separate concept identifier, **is a row-level dataset comparing modelled benchmarks before and after an upstream public source release changed**, titled as benchmark changes for a public hospital cost-reporting system and credited to an organisation rather than a person. **Measured this round**: **registered as a dataset**, **licensed under a Creative Commons attribution licence**, **created on the registry 2026-09-08**, with **six files inside**, the main table being about three hundred and eighty-eight kilobytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of registry discipline, here stating what the numbers are not.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata, the package readme and the data package description**: **first, what the data is and what it is not are written side by side**: verbatim, this is a deterministic model-source comparison, it is not a live job posting index, a package quote, a paycheck estimate or proof that available assignments changed by the same percentage, and the values are modelled gross-wage benchmarks before tax that exclude stipends, overtime, reimbursements, insurance and other package components. **The four negations correspond to the four most likely misreadings, namely real-time demand, an offered rate, take-home pay and a change in available work; whether a dataset can be misused often depends on whether it states its own boundary first.** **Second, attribution is cut cleanly while the upstream status is preserved**: verbatim, the derived conclusions are not attributable to the public agencies whose materials feed the product, the source materials retain their original public-domain or government-work status and notices, and the original derived release is offered under a Creative Commons attribution licence. **The licence of the derived layer and the status of the source layer are two different things, stated separately.** **Third, the previous and current benchmarks sit in the same row and both source keys are recorded**: verbatim, the package contains one thousand five hundred and forty comparable occupation and location rows before and after the validated source transition between two dated release keys, and the data package description lists both keys as sources, while each row carries a previous and a current source key, so any single row can answer which release it came from. **Fourth, the field schema is written out with types and an enumeration**: fourteen fields measured, including a permanent report identifier, occupation and geography labels with a slug and a geography type restricted to two values, previous, current and change amounts in whole currency units, a percentage change, the two source keys, an ISO publication date, and a benchmark URL declared as a URI, which means every row can be followed back to its public page. **Fifth, the role of each of the six files is listed and an executable verification instruction is given**: verbatim, readers are told to run a checksum command from the directory to verify the downloaded files, which is more useful than merely shipping a checksum file because the user does not have to know how to use it. **Sixth, five provenance entry points are listed**, covering methodology, a source registry, a data dictionary, a **corrections policy** and a reuse licence, and giving corrections its own page is worth noting because how a dataset is corrected is part of its credibility. **Seventh, two dates disagree, as measured here**: both the readme and the data package description state a publication date of 2026-07-19 with version 1.0.0, while the registry record was created on 2026-09-08, and **this entry records both dates side by side without reconciling them**. **Eighth, topical relevance is stated honestly**: the content is occupation and geography wage benchmarks for travel healthcare staffing, which sits on the cost side of health insurance, and the fields contain no claims, policy or health-outcome data, **so this entry places it as a health-insurance cost input and states plainly that it is not insurance data itself**. **Ninth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a constants dataset in which every value carries its publishing agency and effective year, federal health programme data and interfaces, hospital price transparency data, risk-adjustment and coding mappings, medical cost modelling and health pricing, **while this entry supplies a row-level before-and-after comparison of an upstream source change that states what it is not, separates attribution from upstream status, carries two source keys and a permanent link on every row, and ships an executable verification step. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled constants dataset and the pooled hospital price transparency interface**; **five practices transfer directly: state what the data is not before stating what it is; separate the attribution of derived conclusions from the status of the upstream materials; put before and after in the same row with the source key recorded per row; carry a permanent public link on every row; and give a verification command rather than only a checksum file**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the main table was not downloaded** — no row read, no percentage change recomputed and no checksum checked — **so no claim is made about the number of rows, the field values or any result**, everything stated here coming from the readme, the data package description and the registry metadata. **Second, whether the checksum file matches the actual files was not verified**, which would require downloading them, nor was the data package validated against its specification; **this is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, how comparability was determined for the stated row count was not verified, nor was the actual meaning of the two source release keys. Fourth, the claim of a validated source transition was not verified**, the methodology page not having been read. **Fifth, the actual data path from the public cost-reporting system was not verified, nor was the market or purpose the product serves. Sixth, the nature of the creating organisation was not verified**, the record giving only a product name, **nor was whether it has any formal relationship with the public agencies it cites, the description stating verbatim that its conclusions are not attributable to them**. **Seventh, whether the data is part of a paid product was not verified**, no link having been visited. **Eighth, the licence is a Creative Commons attribution licence, while the upstream materials are stated to retain their public-domain or government-work status, so both should be credited.** **Ninth, on the window: the registry record was created 2026-09-08, inside the thaw window, while the package states a publication date of 2026-07-19, outside it, and this entry records both. Tenth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the data is neither insurance data nor any basis for a wage or rate, and must not be used for any real staffing-cost or premium judgement.**
